Trace, implement and test: Remove Non Alphabets

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package Problems_On_String;

import java.util.Scanner;

public class RemoveNonAlphabets {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.println("enter the Word:");
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        String res = "";
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            if ((c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122)) {
                res = res + c;
            }
        }
        System.out.println("the string with removing non alphabets is " + res);
        sc.close();
    }

}
